old_problem: A final Gen4 link state cannot prove that each counted cycle began at Gen2, traversed the approved Gen4 equalization path, retained width and remained error-free. The original review therefore awaited tool, topology, capability and recovery bindings.
disposition_reason: The source unambiguously fixes the named operation, transition pair, count and clean expected result. Vendor command, topology, start enforcement, equalization timing, error limits and recovery are safe runtime Project Configuration; they do not require a new review decision. A fail-closed per-cycle ledger preserves the distinct Gen2-to-Gen4 coverage.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2107, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2108 / Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00029-V002 / ba9eddf296a46afd was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Speed Change 24 specifically covers Gen2-to-Gen4 and cannot inherit Gen1-to-Gen4, Gen2-to-Gen3, Gen2-to-Gen5 or final-state-only results.
Bind the exact approved LTSSM/NVQual Speed Change 24 action and immutable root-port/switch/retimer/backplane/endpoint/GPU/lane topology before execution.

Before every numbered request, independently prove the mapped link is at Gen2 and required full width; then record the Gen4 request, equalization/LTSSM trajectory, settle deadline, final speed/width, enumeration and fresh error deltas.
A transaction is counted only when all start, transition, target and health artifacts are durable; preserve all 500 chronological entries.
Stop before the next request on unsupported Gen4, invalid start, equalization/retrain failure, width loss, endpoint/sibling loss, new disqualifying AER, reset, log gap or platform safety anomaly.
Preserve baseline and first-fault evidence, never clear logs or automatically retry, and use only the signed recovery path.
No LTSSM/NVQual, Gen2/Gen4 speed change, retraining, PCIe query, recovery, retry or DUT operation was performed.

test_case.test_name: Capability- and start-verified Speed Change 24: 500 Gen2-to-Gen4 transactions
test_case.purpose: Prove the mapped GB-NV-PVP PCIe path completes five hundred genuine full-width Gen2-to-Gen4 transitions within the approved equalization/settle envelope without disqualifying link or platform errors.
required_package: Pinned approved NVIDIA LTSSM/NVQual Speed Change 24 build, command and configuration
Immutable Gen4-capable root-port/switch/retimer/backplane/endpoint/GPU/lane path and expected width
Approved method proving Gen2/full-width start before every transaction
Gen4 request, equalization/LTSSM/settle/transient/error acceptance and exact 500-count rules
Dedicated SUT, durable ledger/interlock, stable power/cooling, console and recovery
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED until Project Configuration is signed. Preserve topology/link/error/health baselines; after point approval execute only Speed Change 24 for ledger entries 1..500. Before every request record and validate Gen2/full-width entry; then capture Gen4 request, equalization/LTSSM trajectory, settled speed/width, enumeration, error deltas and health before enabling the next cycle. Stop at first invalid start, capability mismatch, failure or evidence gap; do not clear or retry.
test_case.expected_result: All 500 entries contain an independently proven Gen2/full-width start and settle to Gen4 at required width within the approved envelope, with endpoint and siblings present, no disqualifying new PCIe/GPU/host/BMC/thermal/power error, and approved final health.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until recipe, topology, Gen4 capability, start method and acceptance limits are approved. Then PASS requires 500 complete accepted Gen2-to-Gen4 records. FAIL on wrong/missing start, unsupported/late/wrong/reduced target, endpoint loss, disqualifying error/reset or recovery failure. Missing input/artifact is BLOCKED; replay cannot erase failure.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until tool/path, Gen2-start proof, Gen4 capability/target, equalization/error/deadline policy, interlock and recovery are approved.
Use an isolated SUT with console, stable power/cooling and immediate point authorization.
Durably preserve every starting, equalization/transition and final state plus all error evidence.
Stop without retry on first invalid start, capability, transition/link/device/error/evidence or safety anomaly.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, Speed Change 24 tool/configuration and approval
Complete path/lane map plus Gen2-start and Gen4 capability/full-width/equalization/deadline/error contract
Ledger 1..500 with raw Gen2 start, request, equalization/LTSSM, settled Gen4/width, enumeration, timestamps and result
Per-cycle error/platform-health correlation and completeness/gap audit
First-fault/recovery or clean final topology/health, no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On invalid Gen2 entry, unsupported or failed/late/downtrained Gen4, endpoint or sibling loss, disqualifying error/reset or artifact gap, inhibit later requests and preserve the first event. Do not substitute adjacent speed-change coverage or retry; use signed recovery and quarantine if expected topology/health is not restored.
